About Us

Welcome to Sri Shivashakti

Sri Shivashakti is a premier Bangalore-based lighting, acoustic sound, and full-scale event management production specialist. We bring magical atmospheres to building decorations, weddings, birthdays, temple festivals, and corporate celebrations.

Equipped with high-lumen Flood Lights, Tape Lights, LED Running Sets, Poke Lights, Par Cans, Moving Heads, Multicolor Serial Lights, and Concert-Grade Professional Sound Systems — all at competitive and affordable pricing.

"From Intimate Gatherings To Grand Festivities, We Bring Light, Sound & Lifelong Memories Together."

What We Offer

Our Premium Services

Bespoke lighting architecture and pristine acoustics crafted to match the grandeur of your special day.

💡
LED Decoration

Radiant multi-tier LED setups that transform buildings, residences, and event halls into glowing landmarks.

🌟
LED Running Sets

Dynamic computerized LED running light waterfalls creating mesmerizing visual motion graphics.

🎵
Professional Sound

Crystal-clear, high-power line array and surround sound setups tailored for speech, DJs, and live music.

🔦
Par Lights & Beams

DMX stage lights, moving head beams, and ambient color washes for dramatic cinematic venue lighting.

💍
Wedding Production

End-to-end wedding production covering mandap, grand entrance, reception stage, and building illumination.

🎂
Birthday Celebrations

Energetic themed party lighting, acoustic music systems, and vibrant backdrop setups for all ages.

🎭
Stage Decoration

Grand stage architecture featuring floral backdrops, chandeliers, LED matrix walls, and golden glow draping.

✨
Complete Event Mgmt

Full planning, electrical logistics, sound balancing, and on-site event execution under one trusted roof.

⚡
State-of-the-Art Gear

Premium LED fixtures, heavy-duty waterproof controllers, and top-tier sound amplifiers designed for flawless performance.

👨‍🔧
Expert Technicians

Over a decade of hands-on expertise in safe high-rise rigging, electrical safety balancing, and stage acoustic tuning.

💰
Affordable & Transparent

Direct producer pricing without middlemen markups. Clear quotes with customized packages suited to every celebration size.

⏰
100% Punctual Setup

We arrive hours prior to the event for thorough testing, sound checking, and lighting calibration before your guests arrive.
